scope_defect.issue: applicability was being evaluated too late, allowing hold/pass outcomes to escape the frozen invariant scope
scope_defect.fix: antecedent applicability now gates policy evaluation before hold/pass decisions

antecedent_semantics.rationale: The frozen invariant ID and evidence fixtures intentionally require both transport qualification and bounded handoff success to make the transport-versus-capability boundary explicit. Out-of-scope evidence must therefore resolve to not_applicable rather than being coerced into hold/pass.

conclusion: Given trusted typed inputs, the deterministic checker now both consumes epistemic polarity and respects the frozen invariant's declared evidence scope without inspecting natural language.
limitations: This still does not solve semantic typing acquisition/trust.
This still does not change production observation contracts.
